0022600159.text: The Detroit Pistons (5-1, first in the Central and 2nd in the East, on a two-game winning streak) visit the Charlotte Hornets (3-4, 3rd in the Southeast and 0.5 games back, on a three-game losing streak) in the Pistons' seventh game of the season. Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), and Charlotte is missing Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel, both out with hamstring injuries. Detroit leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 97-89 win in Detroit on October 28, and the Pistons also won the 2025-26 series 3-0.
